title: Slice 1: cucumber-js foundation and the budget jobs in TypeScript
description:
Hard cutover of the scheduled budget jobs to TypeScript, plus the foundation every later slice reuses.

- cucumber-js 13.3.0 runs TypeScript steps directly (Node type stripping) from conversation/features-support/. A ported-features manifest drives cucumber-js, and behave excludes the same features.
- The DailyBudgetRollup and BudgetAlertRecorder Lambdas are now Node 22, built from conversation/src/budget/ (Cost Explorer, rollup runner, alert publishing, threshold state).
- features/daily_budget_rollup.feature (18 scenarios) runs under cucumber-js with its Gherkin unchanged.
- Python deleted: the budget_rollup runner, lambda handler and alert recorder, budget_alerts.py, cost_explorer.py, their tests and steps, and the rollup/threshold write paths.
- The Python spend-ceiling reader (organization_spend.py and get_budget_rollup_row) stays unchanged until slice 2 deletes all remaining Python. A vitest contract test proves the TypeScript-written rollup rows parse in Python.

Feature: Daily budget rollup (features/daily_budget_rollup.feature, ported unchanged)
  Scenario: The rollup runs on the TypeScript jobs
    Given the daily budget rollup scenarios
    When they run under cucumber-js against the TypeScript budget jobs
    Then all 18 pass and behave no longer runs them

Implemented from a Sonnet prototype that was verified against every gate: behave 674 scenarios, pytest, cucumber-js 18, vitest 58, infra tests and synth.
